{{Top|leg}}
A '''soliton antenna''' was a sensor device used for ship-to-ship tracking in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. It operated by detecting the [[soliton wave]] produced by vessels during a lightspeed jump. It is not clear whether it was possible to locate ships accurately with this device, or simply to observe when they moved between hyperspace and [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], an event known as a [[soliton change]].

The device could lose accuracy if it was not cooled down between uses, and the compression wave produced by the tracking ship could also obscure the signals from other vessels.

By [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], soliton antennae were in use aboard warships in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], such as the ''[[Gorath]]'' and ''[[Tobay]]'' of the [[Grand Imperial Navy]]. It is not clear if the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had comparable technology.

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Wikipedia:soliton|soliton]] and [[Wikipedia:longitudinal wave|compression wave]] are both types of real-world waveform.
